previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for a scheduled bronchoscopy with balloon dilation due to recurrent tracheobronchial stenosis from relapsing polychondritis and Ruvalcaba-Myhre-Smith syndrome. The procedure was performed without complications, and he was observed post-operatively. His breathing remained stable, and pain was controlled with oxycodone. Elevated white blood cell count persisted but was attributed to chronic inflammation rather than active infection, supported by the absence of fever or increased secretions. He was started on a prednisone taper from 50 mg to his baseline 7.5 mg and discharged home in stable condition with follow-up planned in pulmonology and rheumatology.
